subject: T008 workflow static proof

proof.method: PyYAML safe_load for ci.yml, security.yml and dependabot.yml
Every workflow uses reference is a 40-character lowercase commit SHA
Workflow and job permissions are explicitly scoped to read, with CodeQL security-events write only
CI includes frontend contract checks, Java quality/unit checks and Docker Compose health; security includes dependency, secret, container and CodeQL scans
Upload-artifact steps run always and retain logs/reports for 14 days
Dependabot covers npm, Gradle, Docker Compose and GitHub Actions

limitations: GitHub Actions jobs have not completed yet; Docker health and repository checks remain runtime-pending.
